svg.title: Addition: carry dependencies and the observed acquisition pattern
svg.desc: Carry dependencies proceed from units toward thousands. Across training, the experiment shows the opposite acquisition pattern, from higher to lower digit places. Four original measured curves show digit-wise test error over 0 to 200,000 training steps for four-operand addition with reversed output. The units digit stays near 90 percent error until about 130,000 steps. The qualitative strip concerns learning across training, not generation order or four separate times of complete mastery. Curves recovered from paper Figure 1b, source SHA256 caeb368a9406f24de8b36c3d44287035e79f53e79bf6e771a2468b1162ab08e4.
svg.title: Addition: carry dependencies and observed skill acquisition
